summary: Vistance Networks, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized an additional $150 million share repurchase program on August 26, 2026, supplementing a $100 million authorization from April 2026. Repurchases may occur via open-market or privately negotiated transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 and 10b-18 plans. The program is discretionary, with timing and amounts dependent on capital, liquidity, and market conditions; it may be modified or discontinued. CEO Chuck Treadway emphasized disciplined capital allocation. This is a capital return event; watch for execution pace and potential earnings-per-share accretion, though no fixed terms or premium apply.
